exercises.question: Which sentence describes a specific problem and its effect? [¿Cuál describe un problema concreto y su efecto?]
options: El fallo afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchas personas. [The fault affects a service on which many people depend.]
El servicio público de transporte funciona con normalidad en toda la capital. [The public transport service operates normally throughout the entire capital.]
Muchas personas trabajan en el mantenimiento de las vías durante toda la noche. [Many people work on track maintenance throughout the entire night.]

exercises.sentence: Se ha producido una __ que afecta a todo el edificio. (avería) [A breakdown has occurred that affects the whole building.]
exercises.english: A breakdown has occurred that affects the whole building.
There is a traffic jam that prevents buses from arriving on time.

exercises.question: Which word describes something that blocks progress? [¿Qué palabra describe algo que bloquea el progreso?]
options: obstáculo [obstacle]
avería [breakdown]
fallo [fault]
